decisionRule: Do not select an app cutoff from the old nine cases. Report every fixed-grid tradeoff; a cutoff supporting direct-answer source selection would need >=90% supported hit@4 and zero unsupported questions with a selection on this small challenge. Failure means these scalar scores alone do not establish direct-answer support, not that all related-topic choices are clinical errors. Actual literal/consent/fusion/budget/legacy/storage and broader quality gates remain necessary.
labels: Directly supporting documents from explicit synthetic wording. Empty expected set means no direct answer in this corpus; topic-related choices may still be returned. Do not label every unjudged related topic clinically false.
